blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模型将用户指令转化为对生成的场景的探索,这需要场景在镜头移动时保持其3D结构,以及每个动作保持稳定效果. 现有基准大多根据测试中的视频的参考文献来评价这些属性,这些参考文献要么是从自己的框架重建的场景,要么是和命令路径一致的、具有自由尺度的相机轨迹。 这种引用可以吸收逐渐的场景变形以及速度和路由长度的变化,因此这些错误可以不被发现地通过. 因此,我们介绍StrideWorld,这个基准在他们判断的动议之前,其参考标准是固定的。 它评价场景的刚性与起始视图的地面-真实几何,以及动作一致性与每个动作的脚步,一个指令的相机运动. 在模型的最初步骤上测量脚步,然后用来测试接下来的步骤,因此每个模型只根据自己的步骤来判断. 其测量结果在制作的视频上经过验证,已知的镜头动作,其分数与人类判断一致. 所有模型除了一个外, 多数模式在采取单一行动时保持稳步步伐。 沿着构成的航线,几个型号经常会停滞,大多数完成的航线都从每个型号自身进步所预测的位置上结束. 只有按照估计的场景深度进行测距的两种模型才能使大多数路线接近这些位置. 在几段剪辑上精细调整两个型号, 在https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld上可公开查阅代码、数据和领导板。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive video world models shift video generation from producing clips for passive viewing to synthesizing environments that respond to user commands [ 45 , 64 , 18 , 28 , 54 , 39 , 38 , 13 , 41 ] . Systems such as Genie 3 [ 33 , 34 , 6 , 45 ] build controllable generative worlds on demand, aiming to offer a new form of interactive entertainment. For the generated content to constitute a world rather than a sequence of individually plausible frames, it must first preserve its 3D structure, without deformation, as the viewpoint changes. At the same time, usable interaction requires the model to give stable feedback to user commands. Basic operations such as moving and turning the camera should have a consistent and predictable effect throughout the interaction.
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模式将视频生成从制作片段用于被动观看转向合成环境,以响应用户指令[45,64,18,28,54,39,38,13,41]. Genie 3[33,34,6,45]等系统按需构建可控基因世界,旨在提供一种新的互动娱乐形式. 要使生成的内容构成一个世界,而不是一个单个合理框架的序列,首先必须保留其立体结构,而不会随着观点的变化而变形。 同时,可用的交互需要模型向用户命令提供稳定的反馈. 移动和转动相机等基本操作在整个互动过程中应具有一致和可预测的效果.

blocks.en: Evaluating whether an interactive world model meets these requirements takes more than measuring the perceptual quality targeted by conventional video benchmarks [ 21 , 22 , 31 ] . Recent benchmarks have therefore begun to assess such models along two axes, spatial consistency and action control. To assess 3D structure, metrics such as those of WBench and MEt3R [ 61 , 2 , 58 , 56 ] reconstruct the scene from the generated frames with 3D foundation models such as VGGT [ 47 ] and Depth Anything 3 [ 30 ] . They then check whether the frames are consistent with this reconstruction. This geometric reference, however, is fitted to the video under test. Since such foundation models can fit seemingly coherent geometry even to inconsistent images [ 35 ] , gradual scene deformation can be absorbed into the reference and go undetected by these benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 评估互动世界模式是否符合这些要求,不仅需要衡量传统视频基准所设定的认知质量[21、22、31]。 因此,最近的基准已经开始按照空间一致性和行动控制这两个轴线评估这些模型。 为了评估三维结构,诸如W Bench 和 Met3R [61, 2, 58, 56] 的度量标准,用 VGGT [47] 和深度 Anything 3 [30] 等三维基模型从生成的帧重建场景. 然后检查框架是否与这次重建一致. 然而,这种几何参考材料与正在测试的录像相符。 由于这种基础模型甚至可以适应不一致的图像[35],逐渐的场景变形可以被吸收到参考中,并且不会被这些基准所察觉.

blocks.en: For action control, the reference raises the same issue. Benchmarks such as WorldScore and WBench [ 9 , 61 , 58 ] compare the recovered camera trajectory with the commanded one after aligning their scales, which accommodates models with different control interfaces. This scale is likewise estimated from the trajectory under test, so it averages out changes in the distance per command. A model whose steps lengthen or shorten midway can therefore still match the commanded path. Loop-closure tests [ 29 , 25 , 56 , 55 , 59 , 51 , 14 ] avoid rescaling but typically assume that opposite commands cancel, an assumption that many current models violate, as shown in App. H.3 . They also test whether a loop returns to its start rather than whether each command keeps a stable effect along an open route. How to test scene geometry and action control against references independent of the video under test therefore remains open.
blocks.zh: 关于行动控制,参考部分提出了同样的问题。 如WorldScore和WBench[9,61,58]等基准,将回收的相机轨迹与指令的轨迹进行对比,在调整其鳞片后,可容纳不同控制界面的模型. 这个尺度也是从试验中的轨迹来估计的,因此它平均算出每个指令的距离的变化. 因此,一个步长或中途缩短的模型仍然能够与指令路径相匹配. 循环关闭测试 [29, 25, 56, 55, 59, 51, 14] 避免缩放,但一般假设相反的命令取消,这是许多当前模型违反的假设,如App. H.3所示. 它们也测试一个循环是否返回它的起始,而不是每个命令是否在开放路线上保持稳定的效果. 因此,如何测试场景几何和对照与所测试的视频无关的参考文献的动作控制仍然开放。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce StrideWorld , a benchmark for scene rigidity and action consistency. Each of its references is fixed before the motion it judges, as shown in Fig. 1 . The Rigidity test places 3D anchors at the ground-truth depth of each start view and checks whether the visible surfaces stay in place as the camera moves. For actions, we measure the stride of each action from the model’s own first four steps, so models with different interfaces need no shared unit of motion. The stride is the camera motion of one command, and it predicts the camera pose at every later step. The Pace test checks whether the camera keeps this stride when a single action is held, and the Composition test checks whether the strides add up along multi-action routes. These routes come in pairs designed to reach the same end, for example the same translations in a different order. Each route is compared with its own prediction and with its partner. The camera is recovered at every step, which locates where a route stalls or drifts from its prediction.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了 StrideWorld, 一个场景僵硬性和动作一致性的基准。 如图所示,每项参考材料都固定在它所判断的动议之前。 1 (英语). 硬度测试将3D锚定在每次起始视图的地面真实深度,并检查可见表面是否随着镜头移动而保持原位. 对于动作,我们从模型本身的前四个步骤来测量每个动作的步数,所以具有不同界面的模型不需要共享的运动单位. 脚步是一指令的相机运动,它预言相机在以后的每一步都摆姿势. 佩斯测试检查镜头在进行单动作时是否保持了这个步态,而组成测试检查该步态是否沿着多动作路线相加. 这些路线都是成对的,旨在达到同一端,例如,按照不同的顺序进行相同的翻译. 每条路线都与自己的预测和合作伙伴进行比较. 摄像头在每一个步骤都被回收,它定位一个路线的摊位或从它的预测中漂移的地方.

blocks.en: We evaluate fifteen open models on 54,600 videos generated from 140 140 start views across 30 30 scenes, as shown in Fig. 2 . All models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves. How well a model preserves the scene does not predict how well it composes actions. When a single action is held, most models move in the commanded direction and keep a steady pace. When actions are combined into routes, however, several models often stall partway. Even completed routes mostly end away from the positions predicted by the model’s own strides. Part of this error arises at action switches, where models carry the previous action over or start the new one slowly. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to their predictions. Existing metrics largely miss these failures, as a reconstruction-based reprojection error detects scene deformation in only three of the fifteen models. When the pace of a rendered video grows by half, a scale-fitted trajectory error flags 43 % 43\% of such videos, whereas the Pace test flags 94 % 94\% at the same false-alarm rate. Finally, fine-tuning two models on 112 112 rendered clips with exact camera paths removes most of their mid-route stalls and more than doubles their Composition scores.
blocks.zh: 我们评价54 600个视频的15个开放模式, 除了一个模型之外,所有模型都会随着镜头的移动而变形。 模型如何保存了场景 无法预测它是如何构成动作的 当进行单项动作时,大多数模型会向指令方向移动,并保持稳步速度. 然而,在将行动合并成路线时,一些模型往往会拖延部分。 即使完成的航线也大多远离模型自身进步所预测的位置。 部分误差发生在动作开关上,即模型将之前的动作带过或者缓慢启动新的动作. 只有两个模型通过估计的场景深度来测量命令,才能使大多数路线接近它们的预测. 现有的衡量标准在很大程度上错过了这些失败,因为基于重建的再预测错误在15种模型中仅发现3种场景变形. 当播放的视频速度增加一半时, 比例尺的轨迹误差标记为43 % 43 %, 而Pace测试标记为94 % 94 % , 以同样的假警报率。 最后,对112 112上的两个型号进行微调,制作带有精确相机路径的剪辑,移除了大部分的中路摊位,并且将组成分数增加一倍以上.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: 1. We propose StrideWorld , which measures scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view and action consistency against each model’s own action strides. We validate its measurements on rendered videos with known camera motion and its scores against the judgments of ten human raters. 2. We benchmark fifteen open interactive video world models and find that most deform their scenes as the camera moves. They keep a steady pace under a single action but often fail when actions are combined into routes. 3. We show that fine-tuning two models on 112 112 rendered clips with exact camera paths removes most of their mid-route stalls and brings route endpoints closer to their predictions without lowering image-quality scores.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下: 1. 我们建议 " StrideWorld " ,它衡量起点观点的地面真实几何特征的僵硬性,衡量每个模型本身行动进展的动作一致性。 我们用已知的摄像头运动来验证它所制作的视频的测量结果,以及它与十个人评分的分数。 2. 我们以15个公开互动视频世界模型为基准,发现大多数场景随着镜头的移动而变形。 它们在单一行动下保持稳步步伐,但在行动合并成路线时往往失败。 3. 我们显示,在112 112个制作的带精确摄像路径的剪辑上对两个模型进行微调,消除了大部分中路摊位,使路由终点更接近其预测,而不降低图像质量分数。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: World models were first studied in reinforcement learning as learned simulators of an agent’s environment [ 15 , 16 ] . Building on video generation models trained at scale [ 5 , 46 , 57 , 1 ] , camera-controlled video models condition an entire clip on a prescribed camera trajectory [ 17 , 65 ] , whereas 3D world generators lift generated content into explicit 3D scenes [ 42 , 38 , 44 ] . Interactive video world models instead generate each new segment in response to user commands [ 6 , 33 , 45 , 28 , 64 ] , given as discrete keys [ 18 , 49 , 66 , 41 , 39 ] , camera poses [ 36 , 44 , 38 , 13 , 60 , 62 , 20 , 40 ] , or text prompts [ 7 ] . To keep the scene stable over long interactions, recent models maintain a memory of past frames, patches, or implicit 3D features [ 54 , 49 , 36 , 62 , 39 ] , condition on an explicit 3D cache [ 38 ] , encode camera geometry in their positional embeddings [ 53 ] , or use reinforcement learning to reduce long-horizon drift [ 50 , 14 ] . Their control interfaces express motion in different units, from key presses of unspecified length to camera displacements normalized by scene depth. The same command therefore moves the camera by different amounts across models.
blocks.zh: 世界模型首先在强化学习中被研究,作为一种物剂环境的学习模拟器[15,16]. 根据规模[5、46、57、1]培训的视频生成模型,相机控制的视频模型在规定的相机轨迹[17、65]上设定一个完整的剪辑,而三维世界发电机升降机则生成内容,形成明确的三维场景[42、38、44]。 互动视频世界模式则生成每个响应用户指令的新段[6,33,45,28,64],作为离散键[18,49,66,41,39],相机显示[36,44,38,13,60,62,20,40],或文本提示[7]. 为了保持场景在长期互动中的稳定性,近期的模型保持了过去帧,补丁,或隐含的3D特征的内存[54,49,36,62,39],条件为明确的3D缓存[38],编码相机几何在其位置嵌入[53],或使用强化学习来减少长视漂移[50,14]. 它们的控制界面在不同单位中表现运动,从未说明长度的密钥压力到场景深度正常的相机移位. 因此,同一命令将相机以不同的数量移动到模型之间.

blocks.en: Early video benchmarks assessed perceptual quality, physical plausibility, and instruction following [ 21 , 22 , 31 , 3 , 4 , 27 ] . Interactive benchmarks add action control and use different motion references, as listed in Tab. 1 . Direction metrics check the commanded motion axis [ 56 , 63 ] , and WorldMark also measures held-command speed decay in optical flow. Trajectory metrics compare the recovered camera path with a reference after scale alignment or normalization [ 9 , 11 , 61 , 58 , 59 , 8 ] , so their sensitivity to pace depends on the reference and the temporal alignment. WorldRoamBench [ 55 ] builds an adaptive reference from each predicted segment’s displacement and compares paths at matched arc length. Revisit tests avoid rescaling by comparing return views, matched portions of retraced paths, or reconstructed scene segments after a loop [ 29 , 25 , 56 , 11 , 61 , 58 , 55 , 59 ] . Similarly, group-action tests [ 51 ] check identity, inverse, and composition relations, and WorldCycle [ 14 ] evaluates endpoint closure, mirrored forward–reverse frames, and phase-aligned repeated cycles. StrideWorld instead uses separately calibrated strides to measure each step on open routes, without fitting the route’s scale or requiring opposite actions to cancel, since each action has its own stride.
blocks.zh: 早期的视频基准评估了知觉质量、物理可信性以及遵循[21、22、31、3、4、27]的指示。 交互式基准增加了动作控制,并使用Tab列出的不同运动引用. 1,方向度量衡检查指令运动轴[56,63],WorldMark也测量光学流中的控指令速度衰减. 轨迹度量衡将回收的相机路径与尺度对齐或正常化后的参考物进行比较[9,11,61,58,59,8],因此其对速度的敏感性取决于参考物和时间对齐. WorldRoam Bench [55] 从每个预测的片段的迁移中建立一个适应性参考,并以相应的弧长比较路径. 重访测试避免通过比较返回视图,匹配部分重访路径,或在循环后重建场景段[29, 25, 56, 11, 61, 58, 55, 59] 来缩放. 同样,群行动测试[51] 检查身份,反向,和组成关系,以及WorldCycle[14]评价端点关闭,反向反向帧,相位对齐的重复循环. 而StrideWorld则使用单独校准的脚步来测量开放路线上的每个步骤,而不适应路线的尺度,也不要求取消相反的行动,因为每个动作都有自己的脚步。

blocks.en: Evaluating 3D consistency hinges on what serves as the geometric reference, which Tab. 1 also lists. Most benchmarks derive this reference from the generated video itself. Like MEt3R [ 2 ] for generated images, they reconstruct the scene and camera from the generated frames with SLAM or 3D foundation models and measure how well the views agree with this reconstruction [ 9 , 61 , 58 , 52 , 56 , 48 , 32 ] . This approach needs no external 3D reference, but the reference is fitted to the generated frames. Because 3D foundation models can fit seemingly consistent geometry even to inconsistent images [ 35 ] , gradual deformation can be absorbed into the reference. Other benchmarks compare generated views with ground truth rendered by a game engine or simulator [ 59 , 55 , 19 ] or with registered RGB-D captures [ 32 ] . Such references constrain the available viewpoints, and control errors can enter the comparison when the generated and reference viewpoints differ. Orbia also evaluates self-consistency at recovered cameras and renders held-out generated views from a reconstructed Gaussian scene [ 32 ] . StrideWorld instead takes ground-truth depth only from the start view and evaluates rigidity at the recovered camera, using disjoint anchors for pose fitting and testing.
blocks.zh: 评估三维一致性取决于何为几何参考,Tab. 1也列出了这些参考。 大多数基准都从生成的视频本身获得这一参考。 如Met3R [2] 对于生成的图像,它们用 SLAM 或 3D 基础模型从生成的帧中重建场景和相机,并衡量观点与这种重建是否一致[9, 61, 58, 52, 56, 48, 32]. 这种方法不需要外部的三维参考,但该参考与生成的框架相匹配. 由于3D基础模型甚至可以适应不一致的图像[35],逐渐变形可以被吸收到参考中. 其它基准将所生成的视角与游戏引擎或模拟器提供的地面真伪[59,55,19]或注册的RGB-D捕获[32]进行比较. 这类引用会限制现有的观点,当生成和引用的观点不同时,控制错误可以输入比较. Orbia还评价了恢复的相机的自我一致性,并使得从重建的高斯场景中产生的观点被搁置[32]. 相反,StrideWorld只从初始角度取地真相深度,在回收的相机上评价刚性,使用脱节锚进行姿势配置和测试.

blocks.en: To provide a 3D reference that is independent of the generated video, every start view comes with ground-truth depth and camera parameters. The benchmark comprises 140 140 start views across 30 30 scenes that span indoor and outdoor, natural and built environments, as shown in Fig. 2 a. Twenty-four scenes are built in Unreal Engine 5 [ 10 ] and provide 104 104 start views with exact depth, and six are real ETH3D scenes [ 37 ] that provide 36 36 start views with depth from laser scans. Preprocessing is described in App. A and results by domain in App. F.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了提供独立于生成的视频的3D参考,每个起始视图都带有地面真实深度和相机参数. 如图2a所示,该基准包括30个场景的140个140个起始视图,这些场景跨越室内和室外、自然和建筑环境。 24个场景建在不真实引擎5[10]中,提供104个精确深度的起始视图,6个场景是真正的ETH3D场景[37],通过激光扫描提供36个36个深度的起始视图。 预处理在App中描述. A和App.F.1中按域分列的结果.

blocks.en: Every model is driven by six basic actions, forward (W), backward (S), left and right translation (A, D), and left and right yaw turns (YL, YR), with pitch evaluated separately in App. A.6 . One step is a single command interval of the model’s native interface. From every start view, each action is held for 16 16 steps under three random seeds. The first four steps calibrate the action’s stride , and the later steps test whether the model keeps a steady pace. Each start view is also assigned eight multi-action routes of 8 8 to 14 14 steps, run with one seed, in which a switch occurs whenever two consecutive steps take different actions. The routes form four pairs, and the two routes of each pair are designed to end at the same place under ideal actions. In the cancel pair, the two routes insert back-and-forth detours of equal length along different axes into a shared base path, schematically W → 𝐀 → 𝐃 → W \mathrm{W{\to}\mathbf{A{\to}D}{\to}W} versus W → 𝐖 → 𝐒 → W \mathrm{W{\to}\mathbf{W{\to}S}{\to}W} . The three swap pairs execute the same translations in different orders, either directly ( 𝐖 → 𝐖 → 𝐃 \mathrm{\mathbf{W{\to}W{\to}D}} vs. 𝐃 → 𝐖 → 𝐖 \mathrm{\mathbf{D{\to}W{\to}W}} ), after a turn ( YR → 𝐖 → 𝐃 \mathrm{YR{\to}\mathbf{W{\to}D}} vs. YR → 𝐃 → 𝐖 \mathrm{YR{\to}\mathbf{D{\to}W}} ), or across turns. All sequences are kept short enough for the surfaces of the start view to remain visible, so that the camera can be recovered from ground-truth geometry throughout. Long-horizon exploration and revisits are therefore outside the scope of StrideWorld. In total, each model generates 3,640 3{,}640 videos ( 2,520 2{,}520 single-action and 1,120 1{,}120 route videos), for 54,600 videos across all models.

blocks.en: We evaluate fifteen open models covering three control interfaces. Five are driven by discrete keys or tokens (Matrix-Game 2.0 and 3.0 [ 18 , 49 ] , SANA-WM [ 66 ] , DreamX-World [ 41 ] , and HY-World 1.5 [ 39 ] ), nine by camera poses (Matrix-Game 3.5 [ 36 ] , HY-World 2.0 [ 44 ] , LingBot-World v2 [ 13 ] , AlayaWorld [ 40 ] , Lyra 2.0 [ 38 ] , EVOKE [ 60 ] , WorldCrafter [ 62 ] , SolarWM [ 20 ] , and HY-WorldPlay [ 39 ] ), and one by text prompts (H3-World [ 7 ] ). Each model runs its released inference configuration, and a thin adapter maps the six actions to its native interface. As shown in Fig. 2 b, a single step moves the camera by widely different amounts across models, and the interfaces share no unit of motion. Because our tests measure motion in each model’s own strides, command magnitudes need not match across models. We therefore use a model’s default per-step command when its motion is clearly measurable and keeps the start-view surfaces visible over 16 16 held steps, and otherwise set a fixed magnitude that does. All command magnitudes are released with the benchmark, as detailed in App. A and H.6 .

blocks.en: A step is stalled if it moves or turns less than 10 % 10\% of its stride along the commanded axis, and a route is completed if its first frame matches the start view, its camera is recovered at every step boundary, and none of its steps stalls. Tab. 2 reports five composition metrics, of which the first three compare each route with its own prediction. Stall (%) is the share of routes with at least one stalled step. End err. (str.) is the median position error of completed routes, and Near (%) is the share of all routes that are completed and end within one stride of their prediction in both position and heading. The fourth compares the two routes of a swap pair with each other. Swap gap (str.) is the median distance between the ends of the two routes of a completed swap pair, which reflects the order of actions because both routes contain the same actions. The Composition score covers both levels and averages s ⁡ ( r ) s(r) of the position and heading errors over all routes and route pairs, with incomplete ones scoring zero, so it combines completion and endpoint accuracy in a single number (App. C ).

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate the fifteen open models on all 54,600 videos. Tab. 2 reports every metric for each model, and Fig. 3 places the headline metric of each test side by side. Fourteen models are ranked, since the first steps of AlayaWorld are too small for a reliable stride. The first three subsections take the tests in turn, and Sec. 5.4 checks the measurements against known camera motion and human judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们评价所有54 600个视频的15个公开模式。 标签2报告每个模型的每个度量,图3将每个测试并列的头条度量。 由于阿拉亚世界的最初步骤太小,无法采取可靠的步调,因此排名为14个型号. 前三个小节依次进行测试,第5.4节对照已知的相机运动和人类判断检查测量.

blocks.en: 5.1 Generated scenes deform as the camera moves
blocks.zh: 5.1 相机移动时产生的场景变形

blocks.en: Most models deform the generated scene to some degree as the camera moves. The measured offset also contains tracking noise, which depends on a model’s resolution, frame rate, and compression. To separate the two, we re-render the true scene along the camera paths of twenty routes of each model in the same video format, which gives a rigid counterpart of these videos, and divide the offset of each model by that of its counterpart on the same frames. Every model deviates 1.6 1.6 to 7.3 7.3 times more than its rigid counterpart, as shown in Fig. 3 a, so tracking noise alone does not account for the excess.
blocks.zh: 大多数模型随着相机的移动而在一定程度上使生成的场景变形. 测量的偏移还包含追踪噪音,这取决于模型的分辨率、帧率和压缩。 为了将两者分开,我们以相同的视频格式重新将每个模型的20条路线的镜头路径上的真实场景重新排列出来,这给出了这些视频的刚性对应,并将每个模型的偏移除以同一帧的对应方. 每个型号偏离1.6至7.37.3倍于其刚性对应体,如Fig所示. 3 a),因此仅跟踪噪音并不能说明过量.

blocks.en: This excess has two possible sources, a scene that deforms over time and a scene that stays rigid at a wrong depth. Refitting the depth of each held-out anchor and the camera freely removes the second. The ratio of Lyra 2.0 then falls to one, whereas the other fourteen models stay at 1.2 × 1.2\times or above, so the excess of Lyra 2.0 comes mostly from a fixed depth error. It conditions each new view on an explicit 3D cache built from estimated depth [ 38 ] , so the surfaces it has already shown keep the same geometry, which suggests that a 3D representation mitigates deformation.
blocks.zh: 这种过量有两种可能的来源,一种是随着时间变形的场景,另一种是僵硬地停留在错误的深度. 反射每个悬锚的深度和相机自由去除第二个. Lyra 2.0的比值随后下降为1,而其他14种型号则停留在1.2×1.2\时或以上,因此Lyra 2.0的过量大多来自固定深度误差. 它将每个新视图以一个从估计深度[38]所建的显式3D缓存作为条件,因此它已经显示的表面保持同样的几何形状,这说明3D的表示可以减轻变形.

blocks.en: Preserving the scene does not make a model follow commands. The Rigidity ranking of the models shows no relation to their Composition score ranking, with Spearman correlations of − 0.01 -0.01 for the offset and − 0.07 -0.07 for the counterpart ratio (App. G.3 and D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 保留场景不会让模型遵循命令. 模型的硬度排名与它们的构成分数排名没有关系,斯皮尔曼的相对比值为−0.01-0.01,对等比值为−0.07-0.07(App. G.3和D.1.).

blocks.en: Figure 4 : One swap pair from each of four models in different scenes. Routes A and B reorder the same translations, so their predicted ends, marked by ★ \bigstar , nearly coincide. Each card shows the last generated frames of both routes and the distance of each end from its predicted end in strides, on an axis logarithmic in one plus the distance, green within one stride. Matrix-Game 3.5 completes neither route.
blocks.zh: 图4:不同场景中四个模型各一个互换对. A路和B路重新排列相同的翻译, 所以他们的预想结尾, 以 \\ bigstar 标记, 几乎一致。 每张卡片都显示两条路由的最后生成的帧以及每端从预测的末端的距离,在一加一的轴对数上显示,在一步内显示绿色. Matrix-Game 3.5既不完成路线.

blocks.en: 5.2 Held actions keep a steady pace
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 行动保持稳定

blocks.en: When a single action is held for 16 16 steps, most models move in the commanded direction and keep the pace set by their first four steps. Twelve of the fourteen ranked models have a median pace ratio within the steady band of 0.8 0.8 to 1.25 1.25 , as shown in Fig. 3 b, and the text-driven H3-World is only slightly faster. The same pattern holds with equally weighted strides (App. E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 当为16个16步进行单个动作时,大多数型号都向指令方向移动,并保持其前4步设定的速度. 如图3b所示,14个排名模型中有12个在0.8至1.25 1.25的稳定波段内有中位速度比,文本驱动的H3-World仅略快. 同样的情况同样具有加权进度(App.E.2)。

blocks.en: Among the ranked models, only DreamX-World changes pace strongly. It accelerates over the first steps of a hold, so its first four steps no longer predict where a held command leads. AlayaWorld moves slowly during its first steps, which makes its stride hard to measure, and its stride-based metrics are therefore shown in grey, left unranked, and marked by † in Tab. 2 (App. E ).
blocks.zh: 在排名的模型中,只有DreamX-World变化速度强劲. 它加速了搁置的最初步骤,因此其前四个步骤不再预测一个被搁置的指挥领导的地方. AlayaWorld在最初的步数中动作缓慢,这使得其步数难以测量,因此其步数的度量标准以灰色显示,未排行榜未排行榜,在Tab中标注为 Q. 2 (第E页).

blocks.en: 5.3 Composed routes stall and drift
blocks.zh: 5.3 由路线组成的障碍和漂移

blocks.en: Once actions are combined into routes, the strides of most models no longer predict where their routes end, as shown in Fig. 3 c. Only HY-World 2.0 and Lyra 2.0 bring more than three quarters of their routes within one stride of the predicted endpoint, whereas most other models do so for fewer than a quarter. Both take camera poses as input and scale translations by the estimated depth of the start view, so the same command moves the camera by a consistent fraction of the scene. Tying commands to scene depth thus appears to help strides add up along a route. The interface alone does not explain this gap, as Near ranges from 3.1 % 3.1\% to 84.3 % 84.3\% across the ranked camera-pose models and the key-driven Matrix-Game 3.0 outperforms all of them except HY-World 2.0 and Lyra 2.0.
blocks.zh: 动作组合成路线后,大多数模型的进步不再预测其路线的终点,如Fig所示. 3 c. 只有HY-World 2.0和Lyra 2.0在预测终点的一段距离内带去了四分之三以上的航线,而大多数其他模型的航线不到四分之一。 两者都采用相机的姿势,作为输入和缩放的翻译,按照起始视图的估计深度进行,所以同一命令将相机移动到场景的一致的一小部分. 因此,将命令绑定在深度上似乎有助于沿着一条路线取得进展。 仅靠接口并不能解释这一差距,因为Near从3.1% 3.1% QQ到84.3% 84.3% ,跨于排名的相机所有模型,而按键驱动的Matrix-Game 3.0 超越了除HY-World 2.0和Lyra 2.0以外的所有模型.

blocks.en: The routes of the other models fail in two main ways, illustrated in Fig. 4 . The first is mid-route stalls , where the camera stops for a step partway through a route, most often when a new action starts. Stalls affect more than a third of the routes in four ranked models, as listed in Tab. 2 , and account for most incomplete routes.
blocks.zh: 其他模型的路线主要以两种方式失败,用Fig来说明. 4 (英语). 第一个是中路的摊位, 摄影机通过一条路段,  Stalls 影响了四个排名模型中超过三分之一的路线,列表为Tab. 2,并计入最不完整的路线.

blocks.en: The second is endpoint drift , where even completed routes end well away from their prediction. The median error is above one stride in eleven of the fourteen ranked models. In four ranked models, the same actions in a different order end about two to three times farther apart than repeated generation predicts. Regenerating the routes with two further seeds shows that this drift is systematic, as a route’s end error is a median 1.8 1.8 to 3.7 3.7 times the spread of its ends across seeds. Part of the error arises at action switches, where some models carry the previous action over and others start the new action with only about half a stride, whereas the leading models keep the same step before and after the switch (App. F ).
blocks.zh: 第二点是终点漂移,即使完成的航线也远未预测。 中位误差在14个排名模型中的11个之上。 在四个排位模型中,同一个动作在不同的顺序下结束的距离比重复的一代预测要远两到三倍左右. 以另外两个种子再生路线表明,这种漂移是系统的,因为路线的终点误差是其终点横跨种子的1.8至3.7的中位数。 部分错误发生在动作开关上,一些模型将先前的动作带过,而另一些模型只用大约半步的速度开始新的动作,而领先的模型则在开关前后保持相同的步骤(App.F.).

blocks.en: Existing control metrics miss much of this, as direction checks miss both failure modes and direction accuracy shows no clear relation to a model’s Composition score. A trajectory error with a fitted scale also misses many failed routes, even when it is given the stride-predicted path as its reference. After fitting one scale, about a fifth of the stalled routes still have an error below 10 % 10\% of the path, and so do about a quarter of the routes that end more than two strides from their prediction. The error also does not show where along a route the failure occurs (App. F.7 ).
blocks.zh: 现有的控制指标错过了其中的大部分,因为方向检查错过了故障模式和方向精确度,表明与模型的构成分数没有明确的关系。 装有比例尺的轨迹错误也错过了许多失败的路径,即使它被赋予了脚步预留的路径作为参考. 大约1/5的停滞路线仍然有低于10%的误差, 错误也没有显示故障发生地点(App.F.7 )。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Which test responds to which known change, pooled over three formats. (a) Share of held videos and of routes flagged by each test at its default threshold when one property of an ideal rendering is changed. Pace flags a held video whose pace ratio leaves the steady band, Near a route that does not end within one stride, and Stall a route with a stalled step. Ideal rows give the false alarms. Flag rules and settings are given in App. G.4 .

blocks.en: 5.4 Measurements are accurate and robust
blocks.zh: 5.4 计量准确而有力

blocks.en: On videos rendered in UE5 along known camera paths, the recovered cameras deviate from the true ones by a median of 1.5 % 1.5\% in translation and 0.3 % 0.3\% in rotation. Adding blur, compression, flicker, or moderate wobble keeps these median errors within 4.0 % 4.0\% and 2.1 % 2.1\% . On the generated videos, other calibration lengths, stall thresholds, and camera-recovery anchors leave all findings unchanged, and the route findings hold when the commands of three models are halved or doubled (App. G , H , and A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在UE5中按照已知的相机路径拍摄的视频上,回收的相机与真实相机的偏差中位数为:翻译中位数为1.5% 1.5% ,旋转中位数为0.3% 0.3%。 添加模糊、压缩、闪烁或中度摇摆使这些中位错保持在4.0% 4.0%和2.1% 2.1% 2.1% 2.1% 。 在生成的视频上,其他校准长度、停顿阈值和相机回收主锚使所有发现保持不变,当三个模型的指令减半或翻倍时,路径结果保持不变(App.G、H和A.4)。

blocks.en: We then change one property of a rendered video by a known amount to test whether each metric responds to the failure it targets, as shown in Fig. 5 . Deformation injected into the rigid counterparts raises the Rigidity offset linearly, while texture drift, flicker, and occluders leave it near its level on the rigid counterparts. The reprojection error of a feed-forward reconstruction, by contrast, responds to texture drift and to blur with compression at least as strongly as to deformation. On the generated videos, it separates only three of the fifteen models from their rigid counterparts, whereas the Rigidity offset separates all fifteen.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们用已知的金额改变一个视频的属性,以测试每一度量是否响应了它的目标故障,如图所示。 5 (英语). 注入刚性对应物的变形使刚性线性抵消,而纹理漂移、闪烁和吸食者则将其置于刚性对应物上接近其水平。 反之,向导重建的再投射误差是对纹理漂移的反应,与压缩模糊,至少与变形一样强烈. 在生成的视频上,仅将15个模型中的3个与其僵硬的对应部分分开,而硬度抵消则将所有15个模型分开.

blocks.en: On the action side, Fig. 5 a applies every test at its default threshold. When each test is instead set to flag 5 % 5\% of the ideal held videos, the Pace test flags 94 % 94\% of the held videos whose pace grows to 1.5 1.5 times. A scale-fitted trajectory error flags only 43 % 43\% of them, because its scale absorbs part of the change. Scene deformation also shifts the recovered camera, which at the level seen in generated videos changes the Near decision of 8 % 8\% to 20 % 20\% of routes but leaves the model ranking unchanged (App. G.4 ).
blocks.zh: 行动方面,菲格。 5 a 适用于默认阈值的每一项测试。 当每次测试都标出5%的 理想的视频时, 适应比例尺的轨迹误差只标出其中的43%的43%,因为其比例可以吸收部分变化. 场景变形也改变了回收的相机,在生成的视频中所看到的级别上,该相机改变了近乎8%的8\%到20%的路线,但模型排名保持不变(App. G. 4)。

blocks.en: The scores also agree with the judgments of ten non-author raters blind to the models and metrics. They rated 160 160 randomly sampled videos for whether the camera follows the commands, with a Fleiss’ κ \kappa of 0.87 0.87 , and the score of each video separates those judged good with an AUC of 0.88 0.88 . On 140 140 completed swap pairs, the pair score separates those judged to end at the same place with an AUC of 0.83 0.83 , against at most 0.74 0.74 for scores with a fitted scale. For two videos of the same route whose Rigidity offsets differ at least twofold, the majority of raters chose the one with the smaller offset as more stable in all 39 39 untied pairs (App. I ).
blocks.zh: 评分也同意10名对模型和衡量标准视而不见的非作者评分者的判断. 他们对160,160个随机抽样的录像进行了评分,以确定摄像机是否遵循指令,Fleiss的oq 0.87 0.87分,每段录像的分数以0.88 0.88分的AUC 0.88分将评为优秀的录像分开。 140对已完成的互换对中,对被判定在同一地点结束的对分进行区分,AUC为0.83 0.83,对分最多为0.74 0.74,对分为适配的比分. 对于同一路线的两部录像,其硬度抵消率至少为两倍,大多数评分者选择了在39对不附带条件的配对中具有较小抵消率的影片,认为其稳定性更高(App.I)。

blocks.en: 6 Fine-Tuning on Rendered Camera Paths
blocks.zh: 6 微调摄像头路径

blocks.en: Along composed routes, several models often stall and most completed routes end away from their predictions, as shown in Sec. 5.3 . Since every command step in a rendered clip moves the camera by an exact displacement or turn, we test whether fine-tuning on a few such clips reduces these failures. We render 112 112 training clips in procedural Blender scenes that share no assets or routes with StrideWorld, and fine-tune LoRA adapters on the non-distilled base models of HY-World 1.5 and SANA-WM.
blocks.zh: 如第5.3节所示,在组成路线沿线,几种模型往往停顿,大多数完成的路线都脱离了预测。 由于制成的片段中的每一个命令步骤都通过精确的移位或转弯来移动相机,我们测试这些片段的微调是否可以减少这些故障. 我们在程序Blender场景中制作了112个112个培训片段,这些片段与StrideWorld没有共享资产或线路,并在HY-World 1.5和SANA-WM的未抖动基模型上对LORA适配器进行了微调.

blocks.en: On the full benchmark of 3,640 3{,}640 videos, both fine-tuned models improve over their base models on every consistency metric without lowering image-quality scores. Stalled routes fall from 72.0 % 72.0\% to 11.2 % 11.2\% for HY-World 1.5 and from 57.9 % 57.9\% to 23.1 % 23.1\% for SANA-WM. The Composition score of both models more than doubles and exceeds that of the released models in Tab. 2 , and the Rigidity offset also falls, by about two fifths for SANA-WM. For HY-World 1.5, we further examine what these gains depend on. They hold on the real ETH3D views although all training clips are rendered. We then randomly perturb the step lengths of the training clips, so that every command step still moves the camera but by a varying amount. Fine-tuning on these clips retains about four fifths of the stall reduction, and exact step lengths add the rest. Tab. J.1 and App. J give the full results.
blocks.zh: 在3,640 3{,}640 个视频的完整基准上,两个精细的模型在不降低图像质量分数的前提下,在每个一致性度量标准上改进了它们的基准模型. HY-World 1.5的航线总数从72.0% 72.0\%下降到11.2% 11.2\%,SANA-WM的航线总数从57.9% 57.9\%下降到23.1% 23.1\%。 两个模型的构成分数都超过双倍,超过了Tab中发布的模型. 2,而"刚度"抵消也下降了,为SANA-WM大约五分之二. 对HY-World 1.5来说,我们进一步审查这些收益取决于什么. 他们持有真正的ETH3D观点,尽管所有的培训剪辑都进行了制作. 然后随机扰动训练片段的步长,使每个命令步骤仍然移动相机,但数量不同. 对这些片段的精细调整保留了约五分之四的摊位减量,而精确的步长则增加了其余部分. 标签J.1和App. J给出全部结果.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: StrideWorld tests interactive video world models against references that are fixed before the motion they judge. It compares the scene with the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and each action with the stride set by the model’s own first steps. Across fifteen open models, nearly all deform their scenes as the camera moves. Most keep a steady pace under a single held action, but their composed routes often stall partway or end away from the positions predicted by their own strides. Two design choices stand out among the stronger models. The one that conditions on an explicit 3D cache preserves the scene best, and the two that scale commands by the estimated scene depth compose routes best. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips with exact camera paths also removes most of their mid-route stalls. Extending StrideWorld to dynamic scenes and full 6-DoF trajectories is a natural next step (App. M ).
blocks.zh: StrideWorld针对他们判断的运动前固定的参考文献,测试交互式视频世界模型. 它比较了场景与开始视图的地面真实几何,以及每个动作与模型自己第一步设定的步子. 超过15个开放型号,几乎所有的场景都随着镜头的移动而变形. 大多数人在单一的行动下保持稳定的步伐,但是他们所组成的路线往往拖延了部分路程,或者偏离了他们自己所预测的位置。 两个设计选择在更强大的模型中突出. 以一个明确的3D缓存为条件的缓存最能保存场景,而以估计场景深度比例命令的两个则最能构成路线. 用精确的摄像路径在几个制成的片段上精细调整两个模型,也移除了大部分的中路摊位. 将StrideWorld扩展至动态场景和全6-DoF轨迹是自然的下一步(App. M).

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准细节

blocks.en: A.1 Start views
blocks.zh: A.1 开始视图

blocks.en: Camera coordinates follow the right-handed OpenCV convention with x x pointing right, y y down, and z z forward. Ground-truth depth is stored as camera-axis depth z z , obtained for UE5 views by scaling the EXR depth channel with the conversion factor recorded for each view and for ETH3D views by aligning the laser-scan depth to the same convention, and 3D anchors are placed only at pixels with valid depth. All control metrics divide displacements by the model’s own stride or by the median depth of the start view, so the internal length unit cancels out. blocks.en: As shown in Tab. A.1 , the four route families vary the translation axes, the lengths of action blocks, the turning directions, and the insertion positions. blocks.en: H.3 Opposite actions do not cancel
blocks.zh: H.3 对面行动不取消

blocks.en: Loop-closure tests assume that opposite commands cancel, but calibrating strides on each action shows that they generally do not. On the cancel pairs (G1), the calibrated strides predict a nonzero offset between the two routes, and scoring against these predictions gives lower composition scores than assuming exact cancellation for thirteen models, by up to 22.6 22.6 points in position for LingBot-World v2. This offset is consistent across seeds, as the predicted offset between the two routes exceeds twice its standard error across the three seeds for 56 % 56\% to 94 % 94\% of the cancel pairs in fourteen models, at least three times the rate expected for a zero offset, and only H3-World stays near chance. On the swap pairs (G2–G4), where both routes execute the same actions in different orders, the two predictions differ by at most 0.2 0.2 points.
blocks.zh: 循环关闭测试假设相反的命令取消,但校准每个动作上的步数显示它们一般不会. 在取消对(G1)时,校准的步数预测两条路线之间的非零抵消,而对照这些预测的得分比假设准确取消13种模型的构成分数要低,而LingBot-World v2的积分则高达22.6 22.6分。 这一抵消在种子之间是一致的,因为两条路线之间的预计抵消超过其标准错误的两倍,在14种模式中,有56%的56\%到94%的94\%被取消的对种子,至少是预期的零抵消率的三倍,只有H3-World保持接近概率. 在互换对(G2–G4)上,两种路线在不同顺序下执行相同的动作,两种预测最多以0.20.2分的不同.

blocks.en: H.4 Model-wide stride references
blocks.zh: H.4 整个模型的参考

blocks.en: Models share no common unit of motion, and their median translation strides span a factor of 80 80 and their forward strides alone a factor of 139 139 , as shown in Fig. 2 b. Three camera-pose interfaces also tie the length of a commanded translation to the scene. HY-World 2.0 sets the median depth of the start view to one, Lyra 2.0 scales trajectories by its monocular depth estimate, and LingBot-World v2 normalizes each trajectory by its largest step. Calibrating a stride on each video’s first steps gives every model its own unit. Replacing it with a single stride per model and action, taken as the median across all videos, lowers Pace score for fourteen models because each video is then penalized for variation across views and scenes as well, but the model order stays largely the same (Spearman ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 ), with Lyra 2.0 first and AlayaWorld and H3-World last under both references.

HY-World 2.0将起始视图的中位深度设定为1,Lyra 2.0通过单元深度估计的轨迹,LingBot-World v2通过最大步骤使每个轨迹正常化. 校准每个视频的第一步, 换成每个模型的单脚步和动作, 在所有视频中以中位数, 降低 14个模型的Pace得分,因为每段视频随后也会因为不同观点和场景的差异而受到处罚,但模型顺序基本上保持不变(Spearman ^ = 0.95\rho = 0.95),其中Lyra 2.0为第一位,Alaya World和H3-World为第一位。

blocks.en: Ten paid research assistants who are not authors rated generated videos through a web interface, blind to the models and the metric scores. All of them gave informed consent before taking part, and each rater worked independently on all three parts of the study. The commanded actions were shown beneath every video with the active step highlighted, playback stopped at the final evaluated step, and an answer could be submitted only after the full clip had played once.

blocks.en: For single videos (Part A), raters answered “Overall, does the camera move stably according to the commands?” A rating of Good means that every step moves in the commanded direction at a roughly steady pace without sudden acceleration, slowdown, stalling, jumping, or drift off course, and raters were instructed to judge camera motion independently of visual quality or surface deformation. For swap pairs (Part B), the two route videos were played side by side and their final frames were then shown enlarged next to each other. Raters judged whether the two routes end at the same place by comparing the position and size of fixed objects such as corners, doors, and pillars in the two final frames. They counted them as the same place when these objects nearly coincide, with an offset of at most about 3 % 3\% of the image width, and as different places when the camera has visibly moved forward, backward, or sideways or turned, or when unsure. For rigidity pairs (Part C), two videos generated by different models from the same start view along the same route were played side by side, and raters chose the video in which the scene keeps its shape more stably, following a few fixed objects such as doors, window frames, and furniture in both videos and ignoring sharpness, color, lighting, image quality, and whether the camera follows the commands. Parts B and C were preceded by worked examples, and both are forced choices. Their instructions were refined after pilot sessions with the first raters, and all ten raters completed both parts under the final instructions.

blocks.en: The analysis was fixed before any answer was collected. The label of an item is the choice of at least six of the ten raters, and items split five to five are excluded. In Parts A and B, item-level agreement is the ROC AUC of the score for the majority label, with 95 % 95\% bootstrap intervals from 10,000 10{,}000 resamples of start views within models, and model-level agreement is Spearman’s ρ \rho between the share of positive ratings and the mean score, resampled over models. In Part C, agreement is the share of pairs whose majority chose the video with the smaller offset, tested against chance with a binomial test. Individual choices are further modeled by a logistic regression on the log offset ratio, with standard errors clustered by rater, and the difference in MUSIQ quality [ 24 ] between the two videos is added as a covariate to test whether raters followed image quality instead of scene shape.

blocks.en: The majority labels of Part A also allow a comparison with other control scores. Direction accuracy is the share of steps that move along the commanded axis or turn the commanded way. The trajectory errors are the root mean square position error over the step boundaries divided by the length of the predicted path, as in App. F.7 , either after fitting one scale or a similarity transform, or with the scale fixed to the calibrated strides. The per-step error is the mean distance between the displacement of each step and that of its stride, in strides, again without any fit. All trajectory errors use the stride-predicted path as their reference, which existing benchmarks do not have for key-driven models. As shown in Tab. I.1 , over the 149 149 videos on which every score is defined, the StrideWorld scores reach an AUC of 0.88 0.88 , against 0.53 0.53 to 0.71 0.71 for the other scores, and the difference to each of them has a 95 % 95\% bootstrap interval above zero. Most of this gap comes from held actions ( 0.86 0.86 against 0.40 0.40 to 0.69 0.69 ), although with 70 70 held videos the interval of the difference includes zero for the trajectory errors with a fitted and with a fixed scale. On route videos, all scores that use the stride-predicted path agree with the raters to a similar degree ( 0.78 0.78 to 0.84 0.84 ), and direction accuracy reaches 0.72 0.72 . On completed routes, the scores that follow the whole route agree better ( 0.77 0.77 to 0.85 0.85 , including 0.82 0.82 for the per-step error) than the route score, which measures the end error ( 0.71 0.71 ), as raters judge whether the camera moves steadily along the way. For this reason, StrideWorld reports per-step diagnostics such as stalls, carry-over, and slow starts alongside the Composition score.
blocks.zh: A部分的多数标签也允许与其他控制分数进行比较. 方向精确度是指沿受命轴移动或转动受命轴方向的步数的比重. 轨迹误差是指以预测路径长度除以的阶梯边界上的根平均方位误差,如App.F.7中,要么在安装一个比例尺或相似性转换后,要么在比例尺固定在校准的阶梯上. 每一步的错误是每一步的移位与其步的移位之间的平均距离,在步态中,再次没有任何适合. 所有轨迹误差都使用脚步预留的路径作为参考,而现有的基准对于按键驱动的模型是没有的. 如塔布所示. blocks.en: Fine-tuning also changes the step size of the model, and doubling the training step magnitude from SFT (H) to SFT (F) scales the translation stride of the fine-tuned model by 1.7 × 1.7\times – 1.8 × 1.8\times and its yaw stride by 1.5 × 1.5\times , which brings its step size closer to that of the released model while keeping the consistency gains. Since the stall threshold is 10 % 10\% of a model’s own stride, we test on the 30 30 -view subset of App. A.4 ( 420 420 videos per setting) whether the stall reduction depends on stride length.

blocks.en: Tab. 1 summarizes the benchmarks closest to StrideWorld, and the evidence behind every cell is listed below with its source sections. The 3D-test column records diagnostics of scene consistency rather than a common protocol on held-out points, and human validation denotes a reported comparison whose scope differs across studies. Benchmarks made public after September 15, 2026 are concurrent work. Of these, Orbia [ 32 ] appears in Tab. 1 and is marked † . StreamEval [ 43 ] , also concurrent, scores whether each online control produces the requested scene operation in streaming generation and is not listed in the table. WorldRoamBench [ 55 ] was first released as WorldOdysseyBench in June 2026. • WorldScore [ 9 ] : Camera and text specifications drive sequential next-scene generation (Sec. 3.1). The camera error fits a translation scale, and 3D consistency is a dense reprojection error after joint refinement of depth and pose rather than a test on points held out from the fit (Sec. 3.3, Supp. C.1–C.2). No held-action pace test is reported, and comparisons between metrics and human judgments are given in Supp. D. • WorldMark [ 56 ] : Key, camera, and text adapters are evaluated for direction, latency, and the speed stability of held commands from optical flow (Secs. 3.1.1, 3.4), and the action suite includes open sequences and round trips (Sec. 3.3). Global Memory uses cross-frame geometry from VGGT- Ω \Omega (Sec. 3.1.2), which makes it a 3D test rather than only an appearance proxy. Forty raters assess selected metrics, excluding Global Memory (Sec. 4.3). • iWorld-Bench [ 11 ] : Three native interfaces are tested on action tasks, camera following, and cyclic memory tasks (Sec. 3.2). ViPE trajectories support comparisons of direction and with reference trajectories, and the symmetry of images and displacements serves as an indirect proxy for scene consistency (Sec. 3.3). The human study covers visual quality and camera control with 12 raters and 16 tasks per model (Sec. 4.2.1, App. E.1) and does not validate rigidity specifically. • WBench [ 61 ] : Key, camera, and text models are evaluated by comparing MegaSaM trajectories with references derived from the actions, together with the consistency of repeated actions (Sec. 4, App. C.4.1), which is a proxy for pace rather than a direct trace of the speed of a held key. Navigation includes open paths and loops (App. A.3), and reprojection with DA3 supplies the geometry tests (App. C.5.6). Four hundred raters compare ten aspects at the granularity of model rankings (Sec. 5.4). • WorldExam [ 58 ] : Camera, action, and text interfaces are evaluated, with camera inputs using their own trajectory as the reference and action and text segments using prescribed directions with magnitude normalization. Open control sequences and revisits through inverse actions are both evaluated (Secs. 3.2, 4.1), and geometry uses cycle reprojection with VGGT- Ω \Omega . Human validation concerns the reactivity checklists and not all geometry metrics (Sec. 5.6). • WorldRoamBench [ 55 ] : A shared keyboard vocabulary is adapted to native key, camera, and text models (App. B.1), and direction labels are complemented by adaptive reference trajectories with arc-length alignment (Sec. 3.2, App. E). Open action sequences and revisits are included (Sec. 4.2). Geometry compares reconstructed point clouds of observations and revisits, and crops of engine references additionally support tests of perceptual consistency (Secs. 3.4–3.5, App. G.2.3). Human verification concerns the physics and subject-memory judgments of a VLM (App. L.2). • MIND [ 59 ] : Key actions are tested at changed action scales (Secs. 3.2–3.3), with action accuracy measured from ViPE trajectories by Sim(3) alignment and relative pose errors, and generalization across the action space measured by the MSE between generated and reference frames (Sec. 3.5). Image MSE between forward and reverse passes tests revisits as an appearance proxy rather than held-out 3D rigidity. No direct test of speed decay under a held command is reported, and a human evaluation is mentioned without a protocol or an agreement statistic (Sec. 4.3). • World Models as Group Actions [ 51 ] : Continuous ego-motion increments are probed with identity, inverse, and local composition relations (Secs. 2.1, 3.3). DROID-SLAM recovers the motion states, and robustness is also assessed by comparing full trajectories across stochastic rollouts (App. C.4, C.7), so “Poses” denotes the recovery of motion states rather than a test of scene rigidity. Neither a pace test for held commands nor a human validation is reported. • WorldCycle (CycleBench) [ 14 ] : Key and camera models are tested on reversible, closed, repeated, and cascaded cycles (Sec. 4, App. A). RoMa evaluates endpoint closure, mirrored forward and reverse frames, and phase-aligned states of repeated cycles, so the evaluation is not limited to endpoints, and the drift over repeated cycles serves as an indirect pace proxy in image space. Neither 3D rigidity nor a human validation is reported. • Orbia † [ 32 ] : Native-interface adapters are evaluated with directional control scores and templates for exploration and revisits (Sec. 3, App. C.1). Geometry uses registered RGB-D, cross-view tests with recovered cameras, and Gaussian rendering of 16 held-out views from 64 context frames (Sec. 4), which holds out views rather than splitting anchors into pose and test sets as StrideWorld does. Twenty raters compare 90 cases across six models and six evaluation tiers (Sec. 5.7), and no pace test for held actions is reported.

blocks.zh: 世界模式作为集体行动[51]: 不断的自我-运动递增是通过身份、反向和地方组成关系(第2.1、3.3节)来探究的。 DROID-SLAM恢复了运动状态,并且通过比较整个轨迹的全线展开(App.C.4,C.7)来评估稳健性,因此,“状态”表示运动状态的恢复,而不是场景刚性测试。 既未报告掌握命令的速度测试,也未报告人力验证。

blocks.en: WorldCycle (CycleBench) [ 14 ] : Key and camera models are tested on reversible, closed, repeated, and cascaded cycles (Sec. 4, App. A). RoMa evaluates endpoint closure, mirrored forward and reverse frames, and phase-aligned states of repeated cycles, so the evaluation is not limited to endpoints, and the drift over repeated cycles serves as an indirect pace proxy in image space. Neither 3D rigidity nor a human validation is reported.
blocks.zh: 世界杯(英语:Cycle Bench) [14]: 钥匙和相机模型在可逆、闭合、重复和级联循环(第4节,App.A)上进行测试。 RoMa评价端点关闭,反向镜框,重复周期的相位对齐状态,因此评价不仅限于端点,反复周期的漂移充当图像空间中的间接速度代位. 既不报告3D刚性,也不报告人类验证.

blocks.en: Orbia † [ 32 ] : Native-interface adapters are evaluated with directional control scores and templates for exploration and revisits (Sec. 3, App. C.1). Geometry uses registered RGB-D, cross-view tests with recovered cameras, and Gaussian rendering of 16 held-out views from 64 context frames (Sec. 4), which holds out views rather than splitting anchors into pose and test sets as StrideWorld does. Twenty raters compare 90 cases across six models and six evaluation tiers (Sec. 5.7), and no pace test for held actions is reported.
blocks.zh: Orbia † [32]: 对原生界面适配器进行定向控制分数和勘探和重访模板评价(第3节,App.C.1)。 几何学使用注册的RGB-D,用回收的相机进行交叉查看测试,高斯渲染了64个上下文框架(sec.4)的16个悬浮视图,这些视图持有各种观点,而不是像StrideWorld所做的那样将锚架分割成姿势和测试组. 20名评分员比较了6个模式和6个评价层级的90个案件(第5.7条),没有报告对已采取的行动进行速度测试。

blocks.zh: 附录M 限制

blocks.en: Strides test consistency with a model’s own first steps and cannot be measured reliably when a model moves too little in its first steps (marked † ). Anchors cover only surfaces visible in the start view, so large turns that move these surfaces out of view leave the measurable range, and we report scores on recoverable subsets alongside the overall scores. For the same reason, StrideWorld does not evaluate long-horizon exploration or revisits, whose references would have to be reconstructed from the generated frames themselves. All scenes are static and the main test scores planar motion, with pitch evaluated separately (App. A.6 , B.3 , and E.3 ). Extending anchor-based and self-referential evaluation to dynamic scenes and full 6-DoF trajectories is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: Strides测试与模型本身的第一步的一致性,当模型在最初的步骤中动作太少时,无法可靠地测量(标记为 ___). 锁定器只覆盖在起始视图中可见的表面,所以将这些表面移出视线的大转弯会留下可测量的范围,我们报告可回收子集的得分,与总体得分并列. 出于同样的原因,StrideWorld并不评价长视距探索或重新审视,其参考文献必须从生成的帧本身重建. 所有场景都是静态的,主测试分数为平板运动,投球分别评价(App. A.6, B.3,和E.3. 将基于锚和自我优惠的评价扩展到动态场景和完整的6-DoF轨迹是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: The Rigidity offset measures departure from the true geometry of the start view, so it covers both deformation over time and a scene that stays rigid at a wrong depth, and the refitting experiments of App. G.3 separate the two. Because the camera is recovered from the same generated frames and tracks that the Rigidity test uses, a deforming scene shifts the recovered camera as well, by a median of 0.64 0.64 strides at 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} of smooth deformation. At deformation comparable to that of the generated videos, this changes the Near decision of 8 % 8\% to 20 % 20\% of the counterpart routes while leaving the model ranking unchanged (App. G.4 ). The Composition score compares where routes end, and the per-step diagnostics complement it along the route.
blocks.zh: 刚度抵消了与起始视图真实几何的偏差,因此既涵盖随时间变形,又涵盖一个在错误深度保持僵硬的场景,App. G.3的重置实验将两者分开. 由于相机是从刚度测试所用的相同生成的帧和轨迹中回收的,变形场景也使被回收的相机也转动,在平滑变形的1×××××1××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 在与生成的视频相似的变形时,这改变了近乎8%的8+Q到20%的对应路线,而模型排名不变(App. G.4 )。 组成分数比较路线的终点,每步诊断在路线上补充.

blocks.en: Every model is evaluated with its native interface and step duration, and with command magnitudes that are the release defaults for some models and set within the measurable range for others (App. A.4 ), so the same route spans different amounts of camera motion and generation time across models. Halving or doubling the command magnitude of three models leaves their route findings unchanged, and restricting all models to routes with a matched amount of camera motion keeps their ranking unchanged (App. H.7 ). After fine-tuning, the median completed route of both models still ends more than one stride from its prediction.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都用其本土界面和步骤持续时间来评价,指令量是一些模型的释放默认值,设定在其它模型的可测量范围内(App. A.4),所以同一路由跨模型的相机运动和生成时间不同. 将三种模型的指令量减半或翻倍,使其路线发现保持不变,将所有模型限制在相机运动量相当的路线上,使其排名保持不变(App. H.7 )。 经过微调后,两个模型的完成路由的中位数仍然结束于其预测的不止一步.
